plotEn:
On the fictional remote Scottish island 'Auk Island', siblings Isla and Sandy have lived alone for 30 years. They hunt seabirds for food, and train themselves to fight off "incomers" from the Scottish mainland. Isla also sees visions of a Finman, who attempts to convince her to drown herself in the island's waters. Scottish council worker Daniel arrives to evict the pair by order of his cruel boss Roz, and is attacked and tied up. Sandy eventually takes an interest in Daniel, and soon proclaims him a friend. When Isla orders Daniel to be killed, Sandy threatens suicide, with Daniel leaping into the water to save him.
After some tension, Daniel earns the pair's fondness after telling them a parody version of The Lord of the Rings, which he claims to have written. Isla also tells stories of a ceremonial drowning on the island, "Giving Oneself to the Sea", with the pair's father being revealed to have died this way. They hold an improvised ritual for Daniel, 'The Way of the Gull', and eventually accept him as one of their own. Isla and Daniel continue to bond, and they quickly develop romantic feelings for one another.
Meanwhile, Roz has sent suspended and deranged council worker Calum to the island to continue the eviction, who attacks Isla and is in turn tied up. Isla takes Daniel on a romantic excursion across the island - ignoring a jealous Sandy - and proposes marriage to him.
